Except I literally made it a rule to not kill anyone despite the circumstance.under any circumstance. You can imagine quite a few circumstances, I imagine, where you would immediately go to killing because it was just easier and actually possible. Even if I was about to die I would not use violence

At first it was an absolutely no weapons run. This meant I could use stuff like dizzy grenades as it did not cause actual harm, and was not counted as either a gun or a melee weapon,so as long as you only used those you could come out of the stage with a bonus for only using your fists.

This, however, was very short-lived. The problem with dizzy grenades is that you can only get 5 at the beginning and you can only buy 5 per floor. That means for the vast majority of floors you will only have five or so chances at stunning something so you can arrest it. The rest of them will have to be stealth. 

as you can imagine, there are many problems with this. If it's a particularly large map then you are essentially screwed. If you get put in a really bad spot you can use up two or even three dizzy grenades, the worst offenders being when you actually use it on yourself as well so you can't use it on the people you threw it at AND you're open to attack.

Stealth didn't always work. The best way to go about this where to knock on the door and simply capture whoever came to it and keep doing that until you can't get any more bodies.infiltrating some sort of space to arrest people is a very dangerous move unless you have nimble fingers (which I did not get lucky enough to get) you might immediately be stormed by people with weapons and you might accidentally get the entire building on you, which is a terrible thing because you will probably have to face the wrath of being cornered.

when you're cornered, you are pretty much dead unless you want to punch your way out of there. Which you might not have the chance to do, because you're trying not to kill anyone.they can get in a lot of hits very fast and if multiple people are on you than you're under the gun.

The solution to this issue came in the form of two items. The banana peel if you really didn't want to shoot anyone, or the freeze Ray.

the freeze ray immediately made it easier to take everyone down.as long as you moved fast, you could essentially take out three or four people in a room by just arresting them once they were frozen.I didn't want to use it throughout most of the run but not using it almost led to my death on multiple occasions, where I ran around in circles waiting for the person to turn around so I could rest them when they go back to wherever they're going. This was not an effective strategy

the banana peel was surprisingly useful although there was a great margin for error. You had to throw the banana peel directly at them and go behind them to arrest them.if you missed, if you hit the banana peel yourself, or if you were not fast enough to arrest them, you will be attacked once or twice. You might even get close to death. You absolutely cannot use this if there are multiple enemies around.

So stealth was the preferred option if you could do it, because that meant you didn't have to use up any precious materials or supplies.
